shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin fell below $78,000 and Ethereum below $2,200, extending recent losses.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced over $800 million in outflows this week, signaling waning investor confidence.
Hotter-than-expected US Producer Price Index data fueled concerns about sustained high interest rates.
Rising oil prices and Middle East tensions contribute to inflation fears and a risk-off global market.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains in Fear territory, reflecting overall caution.
